rationale: The function calls `entry.get("expiration_ts")` without providing a default value. If a record fetched from `item_database` is missing the `"expiration_ts"` key, `.get()` will return `None`. The subsequent comparison `time.time() > None` will raise a `TypeError`, causing the function to crash. This constitutes a failure to handle a degenerate input (a malformed record), which is a form of missing edge case.
